title: Parallel-plate capacitor with edge effect (2D, 3D)
description: Capacitance of thin plates from the field energy of a finite-volume solution, refined three times and Richardson-extrapolated: strips in 2-D against Palmer's edge correction, discs in 3-D against Kirchhoff's formula. The excess over eps A / d is the fringing field.
